messages:
raj: Noticed a customer report: Console shows a sudden dip in tokens for a long-running streaming call that retried+resumed across a routing boundary. Ledger shows full tokens. Console grouped by stream_id so looks like a short session. Anyone seen this pattern?

lucy: I saw a similar alert in prod last week. When router does region-failover we create a new stream_id and keep writing token rows under the new_id, but the console dashboard query buckets by first_stream_id only.

toni: Interesting. Do we still emit continuity metadata on resume? I thought we had provenance.tracelet but maybe it's optional on some codepaths.

raj: Logs from the incident: 
```
[INFO] stream.start stream_id=st-0001 tracelet=tr-A retry=0
[INFO] route.fallback stream_id=st-0001 -> st-0002 tracelet=tr-A retry=1
[INFO] toolcall.exec stream_id=st-0002 tool=embedder tokens=40
[INFO] tail.chunk stream_id=st-0002 tokens=160
```
Console sums by start_stream_id so only saw 40, ledger by tracelet saw 200.

lucy: So two problems: (1) stream_id churn on fallback, (2) console grouping key is brittle.

toni: Short term fix idea: make the ingestion pipeline emit canonical_trace = tracelet if present, else stream_id. Then update console query to prefer canonical_trace for aggregation. Low risk and backward-compatible.

raj: Can we also surface toolcall attribution in the console breakdown? Right now toolcall tokens appear under the active stream bucket but not in the per-request timeline. That's what confused the customer.

ui-team: We can add a small timeline row that labels tokens by attribution_type (stream|toolcall) and joins on canonical_trace. UX change is minor — a toggle to include toolcalls.

lucy: One gotcha: some legacy clients don't send tracelet. We need to ensure canonical_trace fallback to initial_stream_id so old rows remain queryable.

toni: Exactly. Also need to ensure retry/reconnect events include prev_stream_id and tracelet in the event body. I can add prev_stream_id in runtime PR.

ops-bot: ops-bot: created job stream_reconcile tracelet=tr-A window=48h. ETA 8m.

raj: Also add an ingestion alert: if we see > 0 resumes without tracelet and without prev_stream_id for more than 2 occurrences in 10m, page eng-platform. That should catch rollouts.

lucy: About billing: ledger uses tracelet as canonical today. If we change console to canonical_trace=tracelet we match ledger and reduce discrepancy. But need to run a one-off reconcile and decide refund threshold.

toni: I'll open two PRs: runtime (emit prev_stream_id) and ingestion (derive canonical_trace). Can one of you own console query change + small UX row? @ui-team

ui-team: We'll take the Console query patch and add the timeline toggle. ETA EOW for the query, next week for UI.

raj: Edgecase: toolcall executed during stream handoff could be double-counted if both old and new stream rows include the same toolcall token. We need idempotency key for toolcall events (toolcall_id). Without that dedupe in ingestion will be hard.

lucy: Good catch. Runtime should attach toolcall_id and tracelet to toolcall events. Toni please add toolcall_id generation when invoking tools.

toni: Will do. Also adding an integration test that simulates fallback+toolcall mid-handoff and asserts console aggregation equals ledger.

ops-bot: ops-bot: reconciliation job finished: tracelet=tr-A ledger=200 tokens, console(current)=40 tokens, unmatched=160. CSV posted to #private-billing.

raj: Yikes. We should prioritize a backfill job to attribute those 160 to the original request in console so customers see consistent bills.

lucy: Agreed. Plan: (1) Ingestion patch to emit canonical_trace (fast), (2) Console query backfill using tracelet join (batch), (3) Runtime PR for prev_stream_id + toolcall_id (next deploy), (4) Reconcile and decide refunds if delta > $threshold.

toni: One more ask: add a dashboard panel that shows 'tracelet vs stream_id delta' over time so SRE/ops can detect routing churn causing split accounting.

ui-team: We'll add the panel. Needs an API from the telemetry store but should be quick once ingestion exposes canonical_trace.

raj: Thanks everyone. I'll file the incident and tag the linked PRs once they're up. Leaving this thread open for PR links and the backfill run status. :thumbsup:
